limits: One synthetic parallel-beam phantom; no acquired scan or clinical accuracy claim.
Released L1-L3 staging exposes both material truth maps and sinograms.

findings: One synthetic 128x128 parallel-beam phantom with 1 mm pixels; paired count sinograms have 128 detector bins and 180 angles, from 0 to 179 degrees. Spectra and material coefficients cover 20-150 keV in 1 keV bins.

All released calibration values exactly match source functions. Selected official NIST ICRU-44 entries differ from the approximate released attenuation table; at 20 keV tissue is 6.44 percent lower and bone 20.02 percent lower. Released arrays are retained unchanged.

The published phantom fixture equals the released truth maps. Forward Radon times 0.1 cm exactly equals stored truth sinograms. Ramp FBP of saved material sinograms divided by 0.1 cm, followed by nonnegative clipping, reproduces both saved maps with zero maximum error in scikit-image 0.25.2.

Actual L1-L3 local seeding copies data/ground_truth.npz, containing both material truth maps and both material sinograms. Source and evaluation directories are not copied. All installation commands were intercepted.

Native scores use the truth-derived 8797/16384 pixel body mask, uncentered cosine NCC, and reference-range NRMSE for each material. Saved tissue NCC/NRMSE is 0.998/0.062; bone 0.9886/0.0404; means 0.9933/0.0512. These are fresh replays of saved output, not a comparison to shipped historical metrics.
The pinned source tree and asset manifest list no evaluation/metrics.json or pass boundaries. Generic results have no pass status; no benchmark pass is established.

Actual filesystem scorer selects tissue_map for 128x128 outputs, even for submitted bone. For 128x180 output it selects bone_sinogram; stacked material maps fail matching. Tissue truth alone and bone-sinogram truth alone each get NCC 1 and MSE 0, although neither is a complete pair of reconstructed maps.
Native reconstructed_maps.npz alone fails the generic reconstruction.npy filename requirement. The non-filesystem fallback searches for absent ground_truth.npy and errors.

Half-density truth keeps native mean NCC 1 while mean NRMSE becomes 0.3058. Erasing bone gives mean NCC 0.5. Adding density outside the body leaves native scores unchanged but changes generic whole-image metrics.

Published spectra, attenuation, forward, Radon and metric fixtures pass to floating-point tolerance. Three saved-ray forward sensitivities match finite differences. No material optimizer, full generator or medical/model trial was executed.
Original cited dex-ct-sim uses Siddon and fan-beam operations; equivalence to this parallel-beam adaptation is not claimed. Both original MIT license holders remain separate.
